about.title:
About
tria
about.description1: Founded in Costa Rica in 2025, tria is a software engineering company that builds products for clients across North America, Europe, and LATAM. From high-converting landing pages to enterprise platforms, we design, build, and scale technology that drives measurable business outcomes.
about.description2: Our team works across the full software spectrum — product design, cloud architecture, full-stack development, data, AI, and security — and we operate as a remote-first company rooted in Costa Rica. Western time zones, cultural alignment, and engineering rigor: that's what our clients get in every engagement.
services.softwareDevDesc: Modern digital products — websites, web and mobile apps, desktop and AI-native platforms — built with cutting-edge architecture and the perfect stack for every challenge. If it runs on a screen, we build it.
services.cloudDevopsDesc: Cloud-native APIs, event-driven systems, real-time data pipelines, and scalable distributed architectures — engineered for performance, resilience, and growth.
services.aiMlDesc: Generative AI, LLM-powered experiences, intelligent automation, predictive systems, and next-generation machine learning — applied to real business problems.
services.itCybersecurityDesc: Zero-trust security, legacy modernization, cloud cost optimization, and resilient infrastructure — protecting and tuning every layer of your technology stack.
services.uiuxDesignDesc: End-to-end product design — research, UX strategy, wireframes, and polished interfaces that convert. We design the experience before we build the product.
services.qaTestingDesc: Automated and manual QA across web, mobile, and APIs — test plans, CI integration, and performance testing that ship with confidence.
services.dedicatedTeamsDesc: Dedicated engineering teams and staff augmentation that embed with yours — your roadmap, your tools, our senior talent across any stack.
services.modernizationDesc: Legacy system modernization and third-party integrations — ERP, CRM, and APIs — modernizing what exists and connecting everything.
process.title: Our Process
process.intro: A disciplined, end-to-end software lifecycle — from first conversation to continuous evolution. Rigorous, transparent, and measured at every stage.
process.step1Desc: We start with your business, users, and goals. Stakeholder interviews, user research, and technical audits converge into a validated roadmap and a clear definition of success.
process.step2Desc: UX strategy, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes validated with real users. We define the experience before a single line of code is written.
process.step3Desc: Scalable system design, technology selection, and sprint planning. Every architectural decision is validated against performance, security, and growth.
process.step4Desc: Agile sprints with continuous delivery, automated testing, and rigorous code reviews. We ship working increments every iteration — visible, testable, measurable.
process.step5Desc: Automated and manual QA, performance benchmarking, and security testing before every release. Quality is verified at every stage — never an afterthought.
process.step6Desc: Zero-downtime releases, observability, and proactive monitoring — then continuous iteration: new features, optimization, and support that scales with your business.
featured.title: Featured Projects
featured.project1Desc: Multi-platform valet and parking management system with web dashboard, mobile apps, and multi-tenant architecture serving companies, customers, and valet staff.
featured.project2Desc: Comprehensive driver and transportation management system featuring OCR pipeline, RBAC security, and real-time delivery monitoring for courier services.
featured.project3Desc: Safety scoring API integrating OIJ crime data, NASA VIIRS lighting, OSM infrastructure, and citizen reports across 137 countries with standardized ingestion pipelines.
featured.project4Desc: Intelligent routing engine that calculates the safest path between any two points on the planet. Weighs road segments based on lighting, crime risk, surface type, and incline using OpenStreetMap data.
featured.project5Desc: Comprehensive web-based root cause analysis tool implementing Ishikawa diagrams, 5 Whys methodology, and corrective action plans with PDF and Excel export for quality management.
featured.project6Desc: Team management platform for tracking groups, matches, players, and statistics. Built as a modern monorepo with a NestJS API, Next.js web application, and comprehensive type safety.
featured.project7Desc: Professional corporate website for Las Granas, a Costa Rican B2B international trade company connecting LATAM businesses with markets in Europe and Asia.

services.engagement.title: How We Engage
services.engagement.intro: One partner for the entire software journey. Whether you need a defined build, an evolving product, an embedded team, or expert guidance — we structure the engagement around your goals.
services.engagement.projectBasedDesc: Fixed scope, timeline, and budget. Best for defined builds — websites, MVPs, and integrations — with clear requirements.
services.engagement.sprintBasedDesc: Fixed-length sprints with clear deliverables each iteration. Perfect for products that evolve with market feedback.
services.engagement.dedicatedTeamDesc: Senior engineers embedded in your team, sprint by sprint. Your roadmap, your tools, your ceremonies — scale up or down on demand.
services.engagement.advisoryDesc: Strategic CTO-level guidance for architecture, security, and technology planning — expertise exactly when you need it.
services.showcase.heading: Capabilities & Expertise
services.showcase.sub: Eight practices spanning the full software spectrum — and every capability in between. Our services are not a closed list: if it involves software, we build it.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: If it involves software, we build it. Our core practices span digital products, backend & data engineering, cloud & DevOps, AI/ML, cybersecurity, and technology advisory — but the full capability map is much wider: UI/UX design, QA & testing, systems integration, dedicated teams, data science, and everything in between. Every engagement is tailored to your specific needs and business objectives.
faq.q2: How does the engagement process work?
faq.a2: We start with a discovery phase to understand your business, goals, and technical requirements. From there, we propose the best engagement model — project-based with fixed scope and pricing, a dedicated team that works as an extension of yours, or strategic advisory for technology planning and architecture decisions.
faq.q3: How much do projects typically cost?
faq.a3: Our pricing is transparent and project-dependent. Websites and digital presence start from $400. Web and mobile applications start from $1,800. Backend, AI, and automation projects start from $2,500. For complex or large-scale projects, we provide a custom quote after understanding your full requirements.
faq.q4: How does the budget estimator work?
faq.a4: It's an interactive estimator: choose the project type (landing page, website, e-commerce, web app, mobile app, backend, AI, or custom platform), the scope, the complexity, and the features you need, and get a realistic budget range and timeline in under a minute. No forms, no commitment.
faq.q5: How long does a typical project take?
faq.a5: Timelines vary depending on complexity and scope. A landing page or simple website can take 2–4 weeks. Multi-page applications and platforms typically range from 6–12 weeks. Larger enterprise systems with AI or complex integrations may take 3–6 months or more. We provide clear timelines during the discovery phase.
faq.q6: How do you ensure quality and security?
faq.a6: Quality is built into every stage of our process. We follow rigorous code review practices, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and performance benchmarking. For security, we conduct architecture reviews, implement OWASP best practices, and follow zero-trust principles. We can also work toward HIPAA or SOC2 compliance when needed.
faq.q7: Do you offer post-launch support and maintenance?
faq.a7: Yes. Every project includes a post-launch support period. We also offer ongoing maintenance, monitoring, and evolution plans to keep your software secure, up-to-date, and performing at its best as your business grows.
faq.q8: Who owns the code and intellectual property?
faq.a8: You do. On completion, you receive the full source code, documentation, and all assets. You own the intellectual property from day one — no licenses, no buyback fees.
faq.q9: How do I get started with my project?
faq.a9: Getting started is simple. Reach out through our contact form or email us directly. We'll schedule a call to discuss your project, understand your goals, and propose a tailored solution — typically within one business day.

about.storyAlt: Team designing and building software around a dashboard
about.heroDesc: We design, build, and scale software that drives real business outcomes. From startups to enterprises, we deliver engineering excellence from Costa Rica.
about.missionDesc: Software is only as good as the results it creates. Our mission is to build technology that moves your metrics — not just ships features — simplifying complexity and scaling with your ambition, from day one to enterprise.
about.history1Desc: tria is founded with a clear mission: deliver high-quality software engineering from Costa Rica — combining nearshore talent with modern, enterprise-grade standards.
about.history2Desc: We ship our first products — landing pages, web platforms, and e-commerce — establishing our full-stack delivery model.
about.history3Desc: Our platforms go live for clients across North America and LATAM, running in production with high availability and measurable results.
about.history4Desc: We expand into AI/ML and data engineering — building predictive models, assistants, and data pipelines for growing companies.
about.history5Desc: A young, senior team that moves fast — we keep growing alongside our clients, one shipped product at a time.
about.teamDesc: A lean, senior team. We keep the team small on purpose — every engineer is experienced, every hand is on deck.
about.valuesIntro: Every decision we make is guided by a set of core principles that define how we build, collaborate, and deliver.
about.value1Desc: We write clean, maintainable code. Every line is intentional, every architecture decision is validated, and every solution is built to last.
about.value2Desc: Automated testing, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines are non-negotiable. We ship with confidence because we verify at every stage.
about.value3Desc: We sweat the details others skip. The polish, the edge cases, the performance — we treat software as a craft, not a chore.
about.value4Desc: We're not vendors, we're partners. Your business goals become our goals, and we measure our own success by yours.
about.value5Desc: Technology evolves fast. We continuously evaluate new tools and approaches so your product gets the best solution — not the safest default.
